notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 default-region object routing surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies ordinary and regional declarations, default-source association replacement and restoration, discovery and reflection eligibility, supplied-empty source-region metadata, and independent subscription cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary and regional object publication, registration, association, subscription, unsubscription, and update services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
